# Status recording

From [GitHub #4](https://github.com/duckAsteroid/brindley/issues/4).

`set_status` enforces the lifecycle, which is right for transitions but gets in the way of
recording the status a document already has: backfilling front-matter on an adopted collection, or
refining a `done` initiative's findings, which currently needs two forced status changes.
